verifiedPaths: Handwritten question draft closes, reloads and restores; title/body constraints are enforced before persistence
Organize and drawing modes expose the same local ask and literature actions
Explicit multi-selection and group selection list placement instances without automatically attaching original evidence
Drawing text is previewed and explicitly converted to a shared question while the original drawing remains
Adopted drawing source element IDs and exact text persist with the question draft across close and reload; restoring through the handwritten-question entry keeps the source when saving
Drawing question source limits accept exactly 20000 characters and 1000 elements; oversized input is rejected without source truncation
Materials and history are explicitly inspectable; a request with no history is submitted with an empty history array
Adding a candidate to discussion does not import it; importing it does not place it; placing it is idempotent
A paper placed beside a problem reopens the same conversation and keeps the original problem root
AI demo answer becomes an editable card, saves with provenance, and is placed beside the original problem

Actual DOM rectangles of the original question, placed paper and AI card do not overlap; title previews are bounded to four lines and author previews to two lines while title attributes retain the full strings

BV08 continuous UI path: import a metadata-only search candidate, place it, open details, attach the unmodified self-authored PDF, retain the document ID/research association/placement, render its real reader and compute a 64-character hash

BV08 selects a real text-layer span through the reader selection actions, adds the resulting excerpt to the same local discussion, returns to the original problem, and saves a demo-derived card whose sole evidence retains the current PDF hash/page index and original conversation
Returning to the original problem consumes its anchor and brings the placement into view
A slow search completed after switching research remains in its original research and conversation
Empty and failed searches preserve the query and allow retry
1440x900, 1280x800 and 1024x800 show one right panel without document-level horizontal overflow; the left navigation collapses at 1024
visualInspection: All eight screenshots were opened and inspected. Final board overview screenshots use existing zoom controls at 80%, 70% and 60% respectively, plus a 115px vertical scroll, to show the linked local context without changing stored node positions.
review: A separate read-only board review identified the drawing-draft provenance reload gap. It was fixed in BoardQuestionDialog and the three production UI tests were rerun successfully; other reviewed selection and anchor paths had no blocking finding.
limits: These UI tests use deterministic literature fixtures and AI demo responses; they are not evidence of live academic search or a real model response.
Real scholarly-provider and native-assistant probes are recorded separately by the integration agents.
BV08 uses a self-authored bundled sample and an explicitly labeled controlled candidate; it is not a live research result or a real research claim.
Drawing images, handwriting and arbitrary shapes are not OCR inputs. Only explicit text elements can become a question.
An oversized drawing source can be summarized manually or selected more narrowly; it is never silently truncated into saved provenance.
